anchors.meaning: Delete request selects a registered object and schedules state35 with parent continuation.
Walk/delete request requires idle target, writes destination and schedules state36/99.
Walking departure enters a16-tick fade only after its walking stages.
Fade completion advances script parent, removes map/queue/template, then unlinks the object; no reward or HP path.
Departure clears registry and queue slot; current removal seeks another enabled slot.
Template removal clears record header except slot0; does not zero vitals or inventory.
Object unlink removes active flag, linked-list and bucket membership; a repeated inactive call is a no-op.
